f3_program: observe(at("group.fully_paid_ordinary_shares.count", "2019"), 1258690067, "count", cell("1,258,690,067 fully paid ordinary shares (2018: 1,313,323,941)", "2019"))
observe(at("group.fully_paid_ordinary_shares.count", "2018"), 1313323941, "count", cell("1,258,690,067 fully paid ordinary shares (2018: 1,313,323,941)", "2018"))
query("absolute_difference", at("group.fully_paid_ordinary_shares.count", "2018"), at("group.fully_paid_ordinary_shares.count", "2019"))
assumptions: Interpreted "nominal difference ... between" as an absolute, non-percentage difference.
Interpreted the requested 2019 average as the mean of the two 2019 line items under "Amounts falling due after more than one year:".
The 2019 deferred-tax entry is an en dash rather than an explicit numeric value, and F3-v1 does not support coercing it to zero.

f3_program: collection("opera_house.seats", "seat", "opera_house", source("An opera house has 150 rows; each row has ten seats"))
observe(at("opera_house.rows.count", "current"), 150, "count", source("An opera house has 150 rows"))
observe(at("opera_house.seats.per_row", "current"), 10, "count", source("each row has ten seats"))
product_relation(at("opera_house.seats.capacity", "current"), at("opera_house.rows.count", "current"), at("opera_house.seats.per_row", "current"), source("150 rows; each row has ten seats"))
observe(at("opera_house.ticket.price", "one_show"), 10, "dollar", source("The ticket costs $10 per show"))
percent_of(at("opera_house.seats.untaken.count", "one_show"), at("opera_house.seats.capacity", "current"), 20, source("20% of the seats were not taken"))

sum_relation(at("opera_house.seats.capacity", "current"), at("opera_house.seats.taken.count", "one_show"), at("opera_house.seats.untaken.count", "one_show"), source("20% of the seats were not taken"))

product_relation(at("opera_house.earnings", "one_show"), at("opera_house.seats.taken.count", "one_show"), at("opera_house.ticket.price", "one_show"), source("The ticket costs $10 per show. How much did the opera house earn from one of the shows if 20% of the seats were not taken?"))
query("value", at("opera_house.earnings", "one_show"))
assumptions: Each taken seat corresponds to one ticket sold at the stated price for that show.

f3_program: collection("necklace.beads", "bead", "necklace", source("A 40-bead necklace is made up of three kinds of beads"))
observe(at("necklace.beads.count", "current"), 40, "count", source("A 40-bead necklace"))
observe(at("necklace.bead_kinds.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("three kinds of beads"))
observe(at("necklace.beads.amethyst.count", "current"), 7, "count", source("There are seven amethyst beads"))
multiple(at("necklace.beads.amber.count", "current"), at("necklace.beads.amethyst.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many amber beads as amethysts"))

sum_relation(at("necklace.beads.count", "current"), at("necklace.beads.amethyst.count", "current"), at("necklace.beads.amber.count", "current"), at("necklace.beads.turquoise.count", "current"), source("A 40-bead necklace is made up of three kinds of beads. There are seven amethyst beads and twice as many amber beads as amethysts. The third beads are turquoise."))
query("value", at("necklace.beads.turquoise.count", "current"))
assumptions: Interpreted "The third beads" as referring to the third kind of bead.

f3_program: collection("community.families", "family", "community", source("a community of 50 families"))
collection("community.pets", "dog_or_cat", "community", source("15 families own 2 dogs, 20 families own 1 dog, while the remaining families own 2 cats each"))
observe(at("community.families.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("a community of 50 families"))
observe(at("community.families.two_dog_owners.count", "current"), 15, "count", source("15 families own 2 dogs"))
observe(at("community.families.one_dog_owners.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("20 families own 1 dog"))

sum_relation(at("community.families.count", "current"), at("community.families.two_dog_owners.count", "current"), at("community.families.one_dog_owners.count", "current"), at("community.families.two_cat_owners.count", "current"), source("In a community of 50 families, 15 families own 2 dogs, 20 families own 1 dog, while the remaining families own 2 cats each."))
product_relation(at("community.pets.dogs.two_dog_owner_group.count", "current"), at("community.families.two_dog_owners.count", "current"), 2, source("15 families own 2 dogs"))
product_relation(at("community.pets.dogs.one_dog_owner_group.count", "current"), at("community.families.one_dog_owners.count", "current"), 1, source("20 families own 1 dog"))

sum_relation(at("community.pets.dogs.count", "current"), at("community.pets.dogs.two_dog_owner_group.count", "current"), at("community.pets.dogs.one_dog_owner_group.count", "current"), source("15 families own 2 dogs, 20 families own 1 dog"))
product_relation(at("community.pets.cats.count", "current"), at("community.families.two_cat_owners.count", "current"), 2, source("the remaining families own 2 cats each"))
member("community.pets", "community.pets.dogs", source("15 families own 2 dogs, 20 families own 1 dog"))
member("community.pets", "community.pets.cats", source("the remaining families own 2 cats each"))
query("sum", "community.pets", "current")
assumptions: The dog counts are interpreted per family, consistent with the explicit "2 cats each" wording.
The "remaining families" form the third disjoint and exhaustive family group.
